data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. It sounds like there may be a cache conflict causing the redirect loop. Please try clearing your browser's cache and cookies for cloudesk.com, or test the login in an incognito window. If the AUTH-SSO-302.1 error continues, please verify that your Google SSO configuration is still correctly set up within the Admin Console. [T-1740] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
